description: Search, create and capture notes in your Obsidian vaults.
author: GPUI Kit

preferences.name: inboxNote
preferences.title: Inbox Note
preferences.description: The note's path inside the vault, such as Inbox.md or Notes/Inbox.md.

preferences.name: defaultVault
preferences.title: Default Vault
preferences.description: The vault Create Note and Quick Capture use first, by name. Empty uses the vault open in Obsidian.

preferences.name: extraVaults
preferences.title: Extra Vault Folders
preferences.description: Vault folders Obsidian does not list, separated by semicolons, such as ~/Documents/Notes. They must be inside your home folder.

preferences.name: searchContent
preferences.title: Content Search
preferences.label: Search inside notes, not only titles
preferences.description: Reads up to 2,000 notes in the background while Search Notes is open.
